name: Jump Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Jump Capital (jumpcap.com), the Chicago early-stage VC firm founded in 2012. Its public LinkedIn company page links jumpcap.com, gives HQ 600 W Chicago Ave, Chicago, and a $350M eighth fund; CB Insights gives the same address and lists its funds as JCDP-4 to JCDP-8, matching SEC Form D issuers JCDP-4 to JCDP-8 LLC (Chicago, IL; Delaware). Separate from Jump Trading (the trading firm) and Jump Crypto: Dealroom and Deep News (2026) say Jump Capital spun its crypto team out in 2021 into Jump Crypto, Jump Trading's digital-asset arm. No fetched page confirms a current ownership link to Jump Trading. Not Double Jump Capital, Jumpstart Capital or Jumpspeed Ventures (other EDGAR filers), and not Jump (jump.ai), the financial-advisor AI startup.

thesis_text.value: Chicago early-stage firm that chooses sectors first, then looks for founders in them. Its 2026 $350M eighth fund backs enterprise AI across North America and Israel: vertical AI applications built into workflows, infrastructure for running AI reliably at scale (data engineering, agent observability, inference), and security for autonomous systems. Earlier funds centred on fintech, application software and infrastructure.

'seventh venture fund', crypto/blockchain focus (Intellectia, Capwolf, Jul 29 2026); 'seventh and largest to date' (Value Add, Jul 28 2026)
conflicts.reason: The 'seventh fund, crypto focus' framing repeats the 2021 news: Jump Capital's crypto team became Jump Crypto in 2021 (Dealroom, Deep News), and the 2026 issuer is JCDP-8 LLC (Form D filed 2026-07-10).

open_items: jumpcap.com (home, /team/, /insights/) returned HTTP 403 to every fetch, so nothing was taken from the firm's own site: application_url, cold-inbound policy, US-entity requirement, team page (titles, focus, LinkedIn URLs) and a firm-reported portfolio count are all unverified. accepts_cold_inbound and requires_us_entity are 'unknown' for that reason; LinkedIn shows it invests in North America and Israel (Pluto is Israeli).

Lead to verify: 'Q3 2026 fund close $350M' (user list). Confirmed as Fund VIII ($350M, reported 28-29 July 2026; CB Insights closing date 7/29/2026; Form D JCDP-8 LLC filed 2026-07-10). The Information article is paywalled and its date not shown; close_date recorded to the month.

Lead to verify: '$100M, 2017-12-07, Chicago' (Shai Goldman list). Matches JCDP-5 LLC timing (Form D 2017-12-04; CB Insights closing date 12/4/2017; Chicago, IL) but no fetched page states the $100M size, so size left null.

SEC EDGAR archive refused the declared User-Agent ('Undeclared Automated Tool'), so Form D amounts, related persons and exact first-sale dates for JCDP-4 to JCDP-8 were not read; only the full-text search index metadata (issuer, file date, Chicago IL, Delaware). EDGAR shows the 2021 issuer as 'JCDP-7 Al LLC', probably a typo for AI. CB Insights says 6 funds; its JCDP-4/5 'closing dates' may be Form D dates rather than final closes. Funds I-III and sizes of JCDP-4/5/6 not found.

Stages: no firm page states them. 'Series A-focused' comes from Value Add (database); LinkedIn and Deep News say only 'early-stage'. Seed is included because Jump led Standard Kernel's $20M seed (Mar 2026). It also led Compa's $35M Series B (Jan 2026), so series_b deals happen but are not a stated focus.
Fund numbers for JCDP-4/5/6 left null: the naming suggests Funds IV-VI, but no page says so.

Relationship to Jump Trading: only the 2021 spin-out of Jump Capital's crypto team into Jump Crypto (Jump Trading's digital-asset arm) is on a fetched page; any current ownership or LP link to Jump Trading not confirmed.

Partners: only Saaya Pal (Partner; quoted on Standard Kernel and Pluto) and Sach Chitnis (Co-founder & Partner; quoted on the 2026 fund) are recorded. Yelena Shkolnik (Partner, quoted on Vinyl Equity) skipped as fintech-focused. Signalbase lists 'Michael M., Co-Founder & Managing Partner' (surname truncated; not recorded). LinkedIn feed posts were not used. Partner focus_sectors are classified from the deals they are quoted on; Chitnis has none assigned.
invests_in_indian_founders not stated. TrueFoundry (founders ex-Meta, 45-person team in India per TechCrunch, US address per its site) is in the portfolio, but the firm says nothing about India.
portfolio_count_reported not found from the firm; CB Insights shows 303 investments and 52 exits (database count, not recorded). Deep News says the team is 15 people across Chicago and New York.

No industrial / manufacturing / supply-chain rounds found in the last 24 months; recent deals are enterprise AI, AI infrastructure, security and fintech. CB Insights also lists Trace Finance Series A $32M (2026-06-17) and TrueDAO $10M (2026-07-10), not researched (outside priority sectors).

Round details not found: Pluto Security website and exact day (Ynetnews/JPost 14 Oct 2026; CB Insights 13 Oct); Vinyl Equity HQ and founding year (Global Fintech Series article dated 10 Jun 2026); Deeto website; Standard Kernel and Compa founding years; Blitzy series label and whether $1.4B is pre- or post-money.
